text.en: LaMa is row 6 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Vision area.
text.zh: LaMa 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 6 行，所属领域为“视觉”。

text.en: The annual table associates LaMa with “Resolution-robust Large Mask Inpainting with Fourier Convolutions”.
text.zh: 年度表把 LaMa 与论文《Resolution-robust Large Mask Inpainting with Fourier Convolutions》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Roman Suvorov, Victor Lempitsky”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 罗曼·苏沃洛夫、维克托·列姆皮茨基；官方英文原文为“Roman Suvorov, Victor Lempitsky”。

text.en: LaMa combines a fast-Fourier-convolution inpainting network, a high-receptive-field perceptual loss, and large training masks to use global context and remain robust at resolutions above the training resolution.
text.zh: LaMa 结合快速傅里叶卷积修复网络、高感受野感知损失和大面积训练遮罩，以利用全局上下文，并在高于训练分辨率的图像上保持稳健。

text.en: The paper identifies Roman Suvorov with Samsung AI Center Moscow and Victor Lempitsky with Samsung AI Center Moscow and Skolkovo Institute of Science and Technology; EPFL and Samsung Research belong to other co-authors in the full paper team.
text.zh: 论文注明罗曼·苏沃洛夫来自三星莫斯科 AI 中心，维克托·列姆皮茨基来自三星莫斯科 AI 中心和斯科尔科沃科学技术学院；EPFL 与 Samsung Research 对应完整论文团队中的其他共同作者。
